<span class="status">Benchtop system. Not an underwater system.</span>

A pushbroom hyperspectral imaging system used on the laboratory bench to study spectral sensing of water and surfaces. It is a perception testbed. It is not fitted to any vehicle.

*This platform supports our research program in [Marine and environmental sensing](../research.qmd#environmental-sensing).*
